results.name: Document projection owns its page, tracking, style rows and counts; model mutation cannot rewrite an older render
Toolbar projection owns formatting/mixed flags and paragraph scalars across style, text, list and selection changes
Comment projection whitelists scalars: comment blocks/XML must not leak through a shallow spread
Header/footer projection owns paragraph rows across editing and page-setup mutation
Navigation, note and revision panes contain no engine aliases and stay unchanged after real engine edits
Inactive panes remain empty; stale selections do not alias the replacement document
